method.hundredItems: 100 distinct Veg Snacks names, including 100 unbroken W characters; all prices 10; GET food stats/orders are empty arrays
method.cartPopulation: Native menu-card element.click(), invoking each real React handler exactly once; no direct React state or DOM content edits
method.reachability: Real page.mouse.wheel vertical scrolling only; no scrollIntoView, style changes, fake layout, submit clicks or order POSTs
method.screenshots: Full-page captures retain the full natural cart layout. Selected footer viewport images show the actual scroll endpoint.
method.largeAmount: Separate one-line browser menu fixture priced at 12345678.99, at 375 and 1440px where selected
method.limitations: UI fixture tests only, not settlement/backend success. Offscreen JS menu clicks intentionally bypass pointer hit-testing. No after-stage comparison is inferred from a before run.
